Good questions

Questions from Quispamsis

Which parts of Quispamsis do you cover?

All of Quispamsis, including Hammond River, Meenan's Cove, Gondola Point and Model Farm. Just outside Quispamsis? Text me at 506-799-2790 and I can often make it work.

How much does permanent light installation cost in Quispamsis?

Installation starts at $200, and your final price is confirmed from a photo of your house. An attached garage roofline is +$75. If I pick up the lights for you, the kit cost plus a small pickup fee is added.

How do I book in Quispamsis?

Text your address and a photo of your house to 506-799-2790, or use the quote form. I'll confirm your price, usually within a day, and same-day appointments are available.

Do I need to buy the lights?

You can bring your own Govee or similar permanent light kit, or i can pick up a Govee kit from Costco for you. The kit cost plus a small pickup fee is added to your quote.

Why permanent lights instead of regular Christmas lights?

They go up once and stay up all year, so there's no ladder every November and no takedown in January. You change colours and patterns from the app, for Christmas or any night of the year.

Do permanent lights need screws or nails?

Yes. Permanent lights have to be fastened to the house with small screws or nails. I show you exactly where they'll go before I start.
